context_length: Single-sequence in this benchmark (E1 also supports retrieval-augmented multi-sequence context)
summary: The 600M Profluent E1 encoder; the larger retrieval-augmented E1 model, used single-sequence here to produce 1280-dim embeddings.
architecture: Retrieval-augmented protein encoder (block-causal multi-sequence attention over retrieved homologs); run single-sequence in this benchmark for 1280-dim per-residue embeddings.
pretraining_data: ≈4 trillion tokens from the Profluent Protein Atlas.
pretraining_objective: Encoder pretraining with retrieval augmentation (homolog conditioning).
key_innovations: Largest released E1 encoder; retrieval-augmented evolutionary conditioning
Reported SOTA zero-shot fitness / contact prediction; permissive license for research and commercial use
when_to_use: As a larger modern ESM-style encoder (1280-dim); again, its retrieval advantage is not used in this single-sequence embedding setup.
caveats: Very recent (2025 preprint); benefit is partly tied to retrieval context absent here. Verify per-size specifics before quoting.
